reasoning: Shows a closed padlock surrounded by a counterclockwise circular reset/rotate arrow. While originating as a mobile UI glyph for screen rotation lock, in a to-do list it serves naturally and distinctly for resetting passwords, rotating security credentials, or changing lock codes. It is easily distinguished from a plain lock by the prominent outer arrow.
